title: I Left the Sticky on the Break-Room Toaster That Only Burned My Bagel

parts.text: I dropped a bagel at 8:09 a.m. and only my slots smoked. Ken from sales ran a bagel two minutes later and it goldened. I was twenty-seven, analyst, standing in a kitchen that made me look like I owned the burn. I opened the crumb tray. Mine was packed; Ken's side had been emptied. I left a sticky: EMPTY BOTH SIDES, NOT THE FAVORITE. Ken laughed, then his next bagel charcoal because I had actually run the clean cycle he had postponed since May. Facilities laminated my sticky. Ken empties both. The toaster finally knows more than one name.

social.video_title: The toaster had a favorite sales bagel — Part 1/1
social.description: Packed crumbs, gold for sales, a May clean. The sticky got laminated. Has an appliance ever skipped only you?
